message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on a lens holder assembly for a headlamp. Headlamp parts fall under 8512.90 (parts of electrical lighting equipment for motor vehicles). The 8512.90 subheading is split into 8512.90.10 for "Of the apparatus of subheading 8512.10 (cycles)" and 8512.90.20 for "Other" (parts of other apparatus). The 8512.90.2000 line covers other parts, and 8512.20 covers other lighting equipment such as headlamps.

Alternatively, it could be a lens-type article for a headlamp classified in 8512.90.9000? I recall that the current HTSUS has 8512.90.10 (Of apparatus of 8512.10), 8512.90.20 (Of the apparatus of 8512.20, 8512.30, 8512.40) with a "Other" line, and 8512.90.90 for other. The more exact current number is 8512.90.2000 for "Other: Of the apparatus of subheading 8512.20 ... " — I'm not certain of the number, but I will go with 8512.90.9000.

Weighing these: the current HTSUS lists 8512.90.10 as "Of lighting or visual signaling equipment of 8512.10 or 8512.20", with 8512.90.1000 covering "Of the goods of subheading 8512.20 (headlamps)", and 8512.90.90 covering "Other". Headlamps fall under 8512.20, so I'll pick 8512.90.9000 as the most plausible answer.

{"hts_code": "8512.90.9000", "reason": "A headlamp lens holder assembly is a part of electrical lighting equipment for motor vehicles, classified in heading 8512 as other parts under subheading 8512.90."}
